page.notes: Top line "Nam in formula nominatim dictum" begins without an indent and the page appears to continue from the previous page, hence cont="true". Page number is printed in an unusual form ("§8o"), read as 580; uncertain. Small stray marks near "legis" and at the bottom are not printed text and were left out. The line "tempus faciẽ di" shows a tilde over the e, read as an abbreviation for faciendi; the word breaks across the line, so the reading is uncertain. "utrū tempore fit institutus, utrū quo nō suus" is copied as printed; "tempore" may be an error for "tempore" with a missing preposition, left as printed. Page ends with the hyphenated "in-", which continues on the next page. No catchword or signature visible.
